finding.rationale: Section 6.1(b) establishes the matching rights period. The Company must give Parent a Determination Notice at least three (3) business days before making a Company Adverse Recommendation Change in response to a Superior Offer or Change in Circumstance. Parent has this three-business-day period to propose revisions or counter-offers before the Company Board may change its recommendation.
